`xposed-api-82.jar` is a compile-only dependency, copied from the existing local Gradle cache (`de.robv.android.xposed:api:82`). It is not packaged into the module APK. SHA-256 is pinned in SHA256SUMS and checked by tools/build.py.

API reference: https://api.xposed.info/reference/de/robv/android/xposed/XposedHelpers.html
Upstream: https://github.com/rovo89/XposedBridge
